native-devices-perf-final.scope:
Native device controls with a concurrent ordinary Linux CPU thread.

Build the static ARM64 guest with musl-gcc -static -O2 -pthread, linking
native-device-controls.c/.S and worker-gpu-native.S. The optional native macOS
GPU reference uses the same C source with DEVICE_NATIVE_GPU and the same
MoltenVK archive. Video surface metadata has no equivalent native Linux/macOS
API and is deliberately omitted from native reference timing.

notes: One subsystem batch; no per-operation integration or replay of unrelated full CI.
No new production unsafe or resource/coordinator thread. Existing private GPU context mutex remains.

GPU timing includes one untimed warmup; native macOS uses minimum features and the same static MoltenVK archive, while Trames also processes runtime capabilities/resources. Contextual native API reference, not identical configuration.
Local ARM Linux test machine has no comparable GPU; no CPU renderer substituted.
Native Linux eventfd is freshly collected; unchanged same-ELF pipe reference reused. macOS has no native eventfd or equivalent video surface metadata API.
Three unprofiled counterbalanced device samples; nine ordinary control samples. No Firefox or physical-iPad FPS claim.
Completed compiler tasks can release their joined handle after result/disconnect publication; unfinished task cancellation retains the existing join boundary.
Fixture configuration failures were corrected with selected reruns; resource/kernel passes reused.
Final native driver idle/destruction and structural mapping/task/filesystem owner boundaries remain.
